_note: Project-level defaults. Every script reads these so repo ids live in one place. Override any value with the matching env var (CKPT_REPO, LOG_REPO, MODEL) without editing this file.

hub._layout: Organisms are uploaded as subfolders named after their stage (rl_hack/, sft_em/, benign_narrow_ft/), so several mechanisms share one repo and stay comparable. The repo name says RL because that is the first organism; the SFT and benign-control organisms can live alongside it as sibling folders, or move to a second repo if you would rather keep names literal.
hub._logs_layout: One subfolder per run name: base_selfmodel/, rl_hack_selfmodel/, rl_hack_rollouts/, each holding manifest.json + *.jsonl.

model._note: Ungated, so no licence acceptance needed. Llama bases are gated and must be accepted as the token's own user first.

run_defaults._triggers_note: Variant 'a' of each family plus both controls. Variants b/c are held out for the cross-variant generalisation test (see Prompts/Experiment/information_leak_prompt.json), so do not add them to the default sweep.
